items.summary: KUALA LUMPUR: Calon Pakatan Harapan (PH), Kerk Chee Yee, 34, muncul sebagai pemenang termuda Pilihan Raya Negeri (PRN) Melaka ke-16, manakala penyandang Ketua Menteri, Datuk Seri Dr Ab Rauf Yusoh, 65, pemenang tertua.
items.titleEn: People's Republic of Malacca: Kerk Chee Yee the youngest winner, Ab Rauf Yusoh the oldest
items.summaryEn: KUALA LUMPUR: Pakatan Harapan (PH) candidate Kerk Chee Yee, 34, emerges as the youngest winner of the 16th Melaka State Election (PRN), while the incumbent Chief Minister, Datuk Seri Dr Ab Rauf Yusoh, 65, is the oldest winner.

items.title: Filipina juara Eurovision Asia, Aina raih tempat keempat
items.summary: BANGKOK: Penyanyi Filipina, Carmelle, muncul juara edisi sulung Eurovision Song Contest Asia 2026 selepas menewaskan 10 peserta lain dalam pertandingan yang berlangsung di One Bangkok Forum, di sini, malam tadi.
items.titleEn: The Philippines are the Asian Eurovision champions, Aina finished fourth

items.titleEn: Ronaldinho is ready to enjoy a new adventure.
items.summaryEn: ROME: Brazilian football legend Ronaldinho will once again feel the heat of competition on the pitch after an 11-year retirement when he is scheduled to make a debut for Italian third division club Ravenna tomorrow.
